# CLUSTER_PROVISIONING

An object in another cluster that reconciles into this one.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

Canonically `provisioning`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.provisioning`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
